extDescription.message: Up to 400% volume, steady levels and a local speech filter. Your audio stays on your device.

offDescSupported.message: Turn on the switch above to boost and balance this tab's audio.

offDescUnsupported.message: Open Tonvela on a tab that is playing video.

levelingHint.message: Smooth out ups and downs automatically.

learnTitle.message: Use the most recently heard level as the target

learnedFeedback.message: This level is now the target.

meterVoiceLate.message: This computer can't keep up with the speech model; try Speech mode.

modeNormalDesc.message: Keeps the natural dynamics of the sound.

modeSteadyDesc.message: Raises quiet parts and tames loud ones.

modeSpeechDesc.message: Makes speech clearer. Does not separate music or effects.

modeNightDesc.message: Softens sudden peaks for calmer listening.

modeMusicDesc.message: Light tone shaping with natural music dynamics.

modeVoiceDesc.message: A local model suppresses the background. Music and effects may not be fully removed.

targetHint.message: Turn on “Keep volume steady” to adjust the target.

resetFeedback.message: Volume back to 100%, mode back to Normal.

errNoExtension.message: Couldn't reach the extension. Close and reopen this window.

errThemeSave.message: Couldn't save the appearance. Try again.

errEngineConnection.message: Couldn't connect to the audio engine.

errUnsupportedPage.message: Open Tonvela on a video or audio page. Chrome settings pages aren't supported.

errActiveTab.message: Go back to the video tab and click the Tonvela icon to start again.

errCannotCapture.message: This page's audio can't be captured. Try a regular video tab.

errAlreadyCaptured.message: Another extension is using this tab's audio. Stop the other audio extension.

errPermission.message: Couldn't access the tab's audio. Click the Tonvela icon on the video tab again.

errNotReadable.message: Couldn't start the tab's audio. Play the video and try again.

errModelRead.message: Couldn't read the local speech model. Reload the extension folder.

errModelTimeout.message: The local speech model didn't start in time.

errModelBrowser.message: The local speech model couldn't start in this browser.

errModel48k.message: The speech model needs 48 kHz audio.

errModelStopped.message: The speech model stopped. Normal audio is back; you can start again.

errProcessing.message: Audio processing stopped. Normal audio is back; you can start again.

errNoAudio.message: No capturable audio on this tab.

errEngineStart.message: Couldn't start the audio engine. Click the Tonvela icon on the video tab again.

errSessionEnded.message: The audio session ended. Start again.

errNeedAudio.message: Play an audible part of the video for at least a second, then try again.

errEngineNotReady.message: The audio engine isn't ready. Try again.

errNoSession.message: No audio session found. Start again.

errStartFirst.message: Start Tonvela on this tab first.
